items.en: My painful experiences and memories make it difficult for me to live a life that I would value.
items.zh_working: 痛苦的经历和记忆让我难以过上自己看重的生活。

items.en: I worry about not being able to control my worries and feelings.
items.zh_working: 我担心自己控制不住这些担忧和情绪。

items.en: My painful memories prevent me from having a fulfilling life.
items.zh_working: 痛苦的记忆让我无法拥有充实的生活。

items.en: Emotions cause problems in my life.
items.zh_working: 情绪给我的生活带来麻烦。

items.en: It seems like most people are handling their lives better than I am.
items.zh_working: 看起来大多数人把自己的生活过得比我好。

items.en: Worries get in the way of my success.

scores.label: 心理不灵活性总分（7题）
scores.description: 七题求和，范围 7–49。分数越高表示越多报告心理不灵活性/经验性回避：被困难想法与感受缠住、并因此干扰行动。不是症状诊断，也不是能力高低。

missingPolicy: complete_required；任一题缺失则该分数不计算，不插补、不补0。
